name: Big Ear Pedals
author: Tone Zone
description: Hand-assembled boutique pedals inspired by BIG EAR pedals (Nashville, formerly BIG EAR n.y.c.): the silicon bread-loaf fuzz (cream, walnut-facia and low-end editions), the 308 Kalamazoo-style distortion, an octave fuzz with its own octave footswitch, a slightly modulated three-knob reverb, the eight-stack ambient modulator with hold-for-alternate modes, a Burr-Brown low-gain drive, a triple booster, an analog-voiced short delay, a mini buffer, one-knob dimed fuzzes, the pizza-slice fuzz (pepperoni and cheese) and the nine-footswitch cascaded booster. Hand-painted enclosures with big painted names, sparkle, candy, wrinkle and wood finishes.
